description: Remote code execution via ssh-agent in OpenSSH before 9.3p2. A remote attacker who can establish a connection to a forwarded ssh-agent socket can force the agent to load malicious shared libraries.
impact: Remote code execution via malicious shared library loading through forwarded ssh-agent socket.
preconditions: SSH agent forwarding is enabled (AllowAgentForwarding yes)
Attacker can access the forwarded agent socket on a compromised host

description: OS command injection via shell metacharacters in hostname in OpenSSH before 9.6 when ProxyCommand or ProxyJump is used with expansion tokens.
impact: OS command injection when connecting to a hostname containing shell metacharacters via ProxyCommand.
preconditions: Attacker controls the hostname the client connects to

description: Information disclosure in OpenSSH client: roaming feature leaks private key material when connecting to a malicious server (OpenSSH 5.4–7.1).
impact: Private key material exfiltration by a malicious SSH server via undocumented roaming protocol.
preconditions: Client connects to a malicious SSH server
